developer_reply:
Thank you for your feedback. 
The application had an option to save goals directly to Google Drive but Google depracated Android Drive SDK two years ago and discontinued service last year. 
As a workaround you can export goals to clipboard and then copy to any document on any platform. 
Later you can import goals back to the app from clipboard.
